 A fake openajar node on this machine: no browser, no model, no account.

╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ up           Run a fake node on this machine.                                │
│ tools        The MCP tools this build serves, listed from the same           │

│ errors       Every error code: what it means, what an agent should do, and   │
│              how to fix it.                                                  │
│ lanebench    The local lane benchmark: test sites, tasks and safety checks.  │
│ text-review  Agent text review: a weekly proposal of clearer text for        │
│              agents, for a person to review. It never changes the node.      │
